title: Capability landscape, view B: which configuration is good at which task
scope: One paper: `paper.tex` (Integer multiplication below n log n, 5,361 lines). Nothing here is shown to transfer to another document (#19).
Each task was tested on its own. No complete wiki has been run with the final configuration (#18), so nothing here shows the stages work together.
Most comparisons are screens: one or a few runs per configuration. The notes give the counts.

comparable: comparable to the chosen configuration, not chosen for cost
reference: the reference the row's comparisons are made against
mixed: mixed (better on some inputs, not others) or best tested but not adequate
below: below the standard or the row's reference
unvalidated: run, but the measure itself is not validated

tasks.label: Extraction
tasks.standard: depth of the extraction (judge-free), and the quality of the plans built on it

sonnet-high.note: as deep as any tested; every extraction tested fed plans judged 19/19 faithful

opus-high.note: as deep as Sonnet `high`, at higher cost

sonnet-medium.note: skims: 4 of 5 first attempts sent back by the coverage check; quotes 11 results against 23.5

tasks.label: Background
tasks.standard: the reader profile and known concepts, judged by the plans built on them

sonnet-high.note: for planning only: every run fed ceiling plans; concept lists vary between runs (median overlap 0.67); its effect on writing is unmeasured

tasks.label: Argument planning (final: combined instruction)
tasks.standard: three blind Opus judges: core results faithful (of 19) and central steps (of 9)

sonnet-high.note: 19/19 faithful and 9/9 central on every extraction tested

opus-xhigh.note: also at the ceiling; not better above it (pairwise: Opus favoured on 2 extractions, Sonnet on 2, 2 tied; p = 0.69)

tasks.label: Argument planning (earlier key-step instruction, superseded)
tasks.standard: faithful core results (of 19), majority of three judges; one run per extraction

sonnet-high.note: central gate 8/8; faithful 15, 7 and 7 on extractions F1, F4 and F8

opus-xhigh.note: +3, +6 and +9 faithful over Sonnet `high` on F1, F4 and F8; the cheapest configuration that improved

opus-max.note: faithful 19 on F1; +1 over Opus `xhigh` on F8, within Opus `xhigh`'s own run-to-run difference, at 5× the cache read

sonnet-max.note: faithful 18 on F1, at about 25 M cache read

opus-high.note: uneven: faithful 14 and 9 on F4 and F8 (Opus `xhigh`: 13 and 16)

fable-high.note: below Opus `max` on the checklist (17 and 16 against 20 and 21); one pilot

tasks.label: Argument planning (original instruction, superseded)
tasks.standard: calibres: Overview (≥ 17 of 19 stated), Research (the central-derivation gate)

opus-medium.note: Overview 5/5, Research 0/5 in five fresh plans (1/2 in an earlier two-run screen); derives less than Sonnet `high`

tasks.label: Writing
tasks.standard: page judge, three blind Opus judges: ≥ 90% of the page's steps derived faithfully and no major error

sonnet-high.note: not adequate on key-step pages: meets the standard on 4 of 12 key-step page-runs; a major error in 1 of 2 runs on page 0015; adequate on the easier page 0014. The gap is underived steps, not wrong mathematics (1 major error in 24 page-runs)

opus-xhigh.note: best tested, not adequate: meets the standard on 4 of 6 new key-step pages, and on 0015 and 0016; better than Sonnet on 2 of 6 new key-step pages (large on 0036), tied on 3, worse on 1. In production only on pages 0015 and 0016 of this wiki

tasks.label: Fidelity audit
tasks.standard: planted errors on six pages: page-error recall ≥ 0.50, source-only recall ≥ 0.50, false alarms ≤ 0.5 per clean page, sham alarms ≤ 0.10

sonnet-high.note: with the source-aware text: 13/13 source-only and 25/28 page errors, 0/18 shams, false alarms 0.50 per clean page by an independent review, exactly at the bound. With the old page-only text: 0/13 source-only, 14/28 page errors

haiku-high.note: page-only text only: page-error recall 0.46 (0.64 under hand labels, a sensitivity analysis); the source-aware text is untested

opus-xhigh.note: page-only text only: page-error recall 0.39 (0.71 under hand labels, a sensitivity analysis); the source-aware text is untested

sonnet-high.note: 0.60; misses both generalisation errors (the source-aware audit catches them: 4/4)

tasks.label: Simulated readers
tasks.standard: reader coverage against a no-wiki baseline, and its drop when key paragraphs are deleted

haiku-high.note: coverage rises with the wiki (lift 0.74), but the baseline is an instructed refusal; deleting key paragraphs lowered coverage by 0.147 against a 0.15 bar (inconclusive); stuck points are not shown to locate missing content. On by default by the author's decision; grading on Sonnet `high`
